propositions: Ruff ARG rule detects 64 unused-parameter violations across src/rebar (48 ARG001, 14 ARG002, 2 ARG005) that fall into six disposition buckets requiring different remediation strategies.

Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers (10 sites across apply_inbound.py and apply_outbound.py) accept unused parameters that are conditionally passed by runtime string introspection in typed_dispatch.py, making unsafe to rename and requiring **_kwargs normalization instead.

Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol parameters (7 sites across jira backends) are pinned by structural Protocol contract and passed by keyword at call sites, making renames unsafe and requiring # noqa: ARG002 instead.
Three tracked real defects (timeout_s, close_reason, acli_cmd) remain deliberately excluded and not fixed in this sweep.

ARG rule is not added to pyproject.toml select due to irreducible ~21 violations that cannot be safely renamed without breaking dispatch logic or Protocol contracts, making a permanent gate infeasible.
